newsitem.title: USA: Management team picked for St. Louis airport plan.
newsitem.headline: Management team picked for St. Louis airport plan.

text.p: Sverdrup Corp said Wednesday it was selected to head a program management team for a proposed $2 billion expansion of Lambert-St. Louis International Airport.

The St. Louis-based firm said it formed a joint venture with Pasadena, Calif.-based Parsons Instrastructure & Technology Group and St. Louis-based Kwame Building Group that was selected by the city after a national search, according to a news release from Sverdrup.
The team will oversee planning, design and construction of the 15-year expansion program, Sverdrup said.

Last month the Federal Aviation Administration released a draft environmental impact statement for the airport project, which was seen by city officials as a major step for the expansion. A final report by FAA is expected early next year.
A St. Louis aviation official has said the project would be funded largely with general airport revenue bonds and possibly with bonds backed solely by passenger facility charge revenues.
